name: Divine Retribution
summary: In Searing Gorge, Kalaran Windblade tells you how his father died and why he seeks vengeance. Stormwind would not hear his plea, so he turns to a brave adventurer.

sections.title: A Father Slain
sections.body: Kalaran says the filth in the cauldron killed his father. He pleaded with the Stormwind magistrate, but no one answered. He says Stormwind would rather deny this part of the world exists than send soldiers to see justice done.

sections.title: A Call for Vengeance
sections.body: Kalaran wants vengeance. Only a lumbering oaf of a squire stands with him, while the Dark Iron dwarves and Ragnaros's beasts could crush him alone. So he trusts a brave adventurer to face the cauldron's denizens. For anyone who helps, he promises riches beyond all dreams.

faq.answer: Kalaran Windblade is a man in Searing Gorge whose father was slain. His squire stands with him as he seeks vengeance.
Kalaran blames the filth in the cauldron for killing his father, and seeks vengeance.
Kalaran says the Stormwind magistrate ignored his pleas. He believes Stormwind would rather deny this part of the world exists than send soldiers to see justice done.
Kalaran names the Dark Iron dwarves and Ragnaros's beasts as threats that could overwhelm him alone.

faq.q: What does Kalaran promise in exchange for help?
faq.answer: Kalaran promises riches beyond all dreams to a brave adventurer who helps him.
